connector.name: MailJunky
connector.registryDescription: Send emails, track events, and manage contacts with MailJunky.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.mailjunky.ai over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.mailjunky. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your MailJunky API key in Bearer format (e.g., 'Bearer mj_live_xxx')
